protocol.description:
This protocol provides a way for clients to communicate a variable number of frosted areas to be rendered within the client area.
This hint can then be used by the compositor to draw fitting backdrop areas.

interface.name: cosmic_frosted_area_manager_v1
interface.description: Manager for creating frosted area list objects for existing toplevels

request.name: destroy
request.description: Informs the server, that the client will no longer use this global. Any previously created frosted area list objects remain valid until destroyed.

request.name: get_frosted_area_list

description.summary: Create a new frosted area list for an existing toplevel

request.description: Instantiate an interface extension for the given xdg_toplevel to specify a list of frosted backdrop areas to be rendered by the compositor.

entry.name: frosted_area_list_exists
entry.summary: the toplevel already has a frosted area list object

interface.name: cosmic_frosted_area_list_v1
interface.description:
The frosted area list object provides a way to manage a variable number of frosted areas for a given toplevel.
If the xdg_toplevel associated with the cosmic_frosted_area_list_v1 object has been destroyed, this object becomes inert. Any further requests other than destroy will raise the toplevel_destroyed protocol error.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: Destroy the frosted area list object

request.description: Informs the server that the client will no longer be using this protocol object. The frosted area will be unset on the next commit.

request.name: add_area

description.summary: Add a new frosted area to this list

request.description:
This request adds a new frosted area which is associated with this frosted area list's toplevel.
If the xdg_toplevel associated with this frosted area list object has been destroyed at the time of this request, the toplevel_destroyed protocol error will be raised.

request.name: remove_area

description.summary: Remove the given frosted area from this list

request.description:
This request removes the given frosted area from the toplevel associated with this frosted area list object.
If the xdg_toplevel associated with this frosted area list object has been destroyed at the time of this request, the toplevel_destroyed protocol error will be raised.

entry.name: toplevel_destroyed
entry.summary: the associated toplevel object has been already destroyed

interface.name: cosmic_frosted_area_v1
interface.description:
The frosted area object provides hints to the compositor about a client area which should be rendered with a frosted backdrop effect.
This includes the bounds within the client window in which the effect should be applied, as well as parameters being passed directly to the compositor's renderer.

request.name: set_bounds

description.summary: Set the minimum and maximum dimensions of the frosted area

request.description:
This request sets the minimum and maximum dimensions of this frosted area within the client area.
The area bounds hint is double-buffered state and will be applied on the next wl_surface.commit.
The value is given in logical space relative to the window geometry of the associated xdg_toplevel. If any value exceeds either dimension of the window geometry the area_too_large protocol error is raised.

arg.name: top_left
arg.summary: top-left corner of the area rectangle

arg.name: top_right
arg.summary: top-right corner of the area rectangle

arg.name: bottom_right
arg.summary: bottom-right corner of the area rectangle

arg.name: bottom_left
arg.summary: bottom-left corner of the area rectangle

request.name: set_blur_radius
request.description:
This request sets the radius of the blur pass of this frosted area in pixels.
The blur radius hint is double-buffered state and will be applied on the next wl_surface.commit.

arg.name: radius
arg.summary: The radius of the blur in pixels

request.name: set_blur_strength
request.description:
This request sets the strength of the blur pass of this frosted area in percent.
The blur strength hint is double-buffered state and will be applied on the next wl_surface.commit.
If the strength value is negative or exceeds 100, the invalid_percentage protocol error is raised.

arg.name: strength
arg.summary: The strength of the blur in percent

request.name: set_noise_strength
request.description:
This request sets the strength of the noise pass of this frosted area in percent.
The noise strength hint is double-buffered state and will be applied on the next wl_surface.commit.
If the strength value is negative or exceeds 100, the invalid_percentage protocol error is raised.

arg.name: strength
arg.summary: The strength of the noise in percent

request.name: set_tint
request.description:
This request sets the tint color of this frosted area packed as RGBA.
The tint color hint is double-buffered state and will be applied on the next wl_surface.commit.

arg.name: color
arg.summary: The tint color applied after blur and noise packed as 0xRRGGBBAA

entry.name: toplevel_destroyed
entry.summary: the associated toplevel object has been already destroyed

entry.name: area_too_large
entry.summary: the associated toplevel's window geometry isn't large enough for the requested area

entry.name: invalid_percentage
entry.summary: the percentage value must not be negative nor exceed 100
